name: Auto Adventures
detailed_description:
Auto Adventures is a free asynchronous PvP hero builder that combines the strategic decision making of a rogue-like with auto-battles against other players. Throughout your adventure you will choose items and skills to make the strongest hero you can while auto-battling other players until you achieve 10 victories, or die trying!

This game features:

  • Hundreds of unique items each with different abilities and effects. Choose items that synergize well with each other to create crazy powerful heroes!

  • Dozens of different monster encounters. Defeat monsters to take their items! Find rare and powerful items from strong monsters.

  • Several different archetypes of items, and skill stats for each. When you level up, choose to allocate your stat points to become better at using certain kinds of items.

  • Asynchronous PVP: During each round you make choices to improve your character, such as buying items or defeating monsters. At the end of each round you then auto-battle against another player's character in a PvP matchup. We use an asynchronous match-making system which means that you can take as long (or as short!) as you want to make your turn. There are no round time limits.

  • A globally shared item pool: When players use an item, that item becomes rarer and will show up in shops less often. This system automatically ensures that over-powered and popular items will stop appearing, thereby keeping the meta fresh and dynamic.
